name: Allegra Krieger
long_description:
New York based songwriter and composer Allegra Krieger brings her singular blend of folk, rock and indie pop to San Fran on 3 December, joined by special guest Elly Mae.

Known for songwriting that is intimate, understated and deeply observant, Krieger pairs soulful vocals with raw, vulnerable lyricism, moving through themes of love, loss and self-discovery with a striking sense of emotional clarity. Her work has earned praise from the New York Times, who described her as a “deceptively understated songwriter,” while Paste has celebrated the distinctive poetry running through her music. 

Having shared stages with artists including Jana Horn, Fust, Johanna Samuels, Shalom and Charlotte Cornfield, Krieger has steadily carved out a space of her own within contemporary indie songwriting, creating music that feels equally at home in moments of quiet reflection and full-band intensity. 

Opening the evening is Pōneke songwriter Elly Mae, whose dreamy guitar-led folk-noir draws from the textures of The Brian Jonestown Massacre, PJ Harvey and Mazzy Star. Since first appearing on Wellington stages in early 2025, she has gone on to perform at Newtown Festival, CubaDupa and Flying Nun’s A Month of Saturdays live series, with RNZ describing her sound as a “woozy ethereal slice of dreampop.” 

Together, the two artists make for an evening of evocative songwriting, atmospheric guitars and music built around the power of close listening.







San Fran holds a Supervised License, meaning minors are welcome to attend events at San Fran so long as they are accompanied by a legal guardian at all times whilst at the venue. Minors are of course not allowed to purchase alcohol under any circumstance.

id: PARK RD - Boyhood Album Release Tour-San Fran, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: PARK RD - Boyhood Album Release Tour
long_description:
Alt-pop favourites PARK RD are hitting the road to celebrate the release of their highly anticipated new album, Boyhood, out November.




Don't miss their first NZ tour in nearly two years, with support to be announced.




Boyhood is a collection of eleven songs capturing the coming-of-age years Tom, Leo, TK and Carlos are currently navigating in their own lives. Led by the singles ‘English Boy’ and ‘Fatal (with Molly Millington)’, the album began taking shape in New Zealand before a second wave of writing and inspiration followed the band’s relocation to Australia. Across the record, PARK RD lean into a lighter indie-pop sound, drawing inspiration from the likes of Fontaines D.C., The 1975 and Ryan Beatty. 




Presave/preorder here - https://ffm.to/parkrd-boyhood

id: Show Me The Body-San Fran, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: Show Me The Body
long_description:
New York hardcore that’s been flipping off the purists for nearly 20 years.

Blast it with jazz horns. Get it plucked to buggery by banjo (yes, hardcore banjo!). Have a good old stomp in the riff swamp and chug out an irrefutable melody. Keep it dynamic and stab it with venom.

Formed back in 2009, Show Me The Body put the sludge back in the morass of modern life.  

Wielding a clash of banjos, bass, drums and electronics, each song seems to gain gears. From slow burners to crashing crescendoes, and a fresh album in tow that ups the ante and draws a new line in the sand.

Dancing at the end of the end. Under the overpass, down the alley, in the basement.

Joining Show Me The Body at all headline shows is Evanora: Unlimited is a multi-medium project from Oakland, California artist Orion Ohana.

Evanora Unlimited Also known Marjorie W.C Sinclair, a secondary & initially secret “catch-all” side project made up of miscellaneous music separate from the Evanora project; evolving over time, has found a harmonious role to the universe of Evanora.

name: Alex Cameron
long_description:
In January 2025, Alex Cameron exploded his life in a controlled detonation largely ignored by the universe. No one was safe. And nobody noticed. The charred remains of Cameron’s life fragmented and reassembled into 9 synthetic rock songs detailing his world’s deep confusion and regret. He continues to find pieces of his own reflection in the shattered characters he creates and embodies. Their yearnings and their humiliations. The promised Messiah. Agamemnon’s appetite for war. Mel Gibson’s ransom note. Humanity’s Pro-War destiny. A cold war breakup. This is the sound of a man walking out on somebody else’s family. Into a new world afraid to remember what it used to be. These are songs of protest against life itself. This is the world our fathers feared. And here is its soundtrack.




ALEX CAMERON

“LATE TO SET”

TICKETS ARE ON SALE NOW

K MOTIONZ RETURNS TO NEW ZEALAND FOR THE LAST EVER CROWD CONTROL

Audiology Touring and George FM presents:







K MOTIONZ (UK) – “THE LAST EVER CROWD CONTROL TOUR”







K Motionz has established himself as one of the biggest names in modern drum and bass, building a reputation for high-energy sets, heavyweight productions and some of the most explosive shows in the scene.

Hailing from Birmingham, UK, K Motionz has risen from breakthrough producer to global DnB heavyweight, delivering anthems including “High Note,” “Hack It,” “Only You” and “Vino Bandit,” while collaborating with some of the biggest names across drum and bass.

At the centre of his live shows is Crowd Control — K Motionz’s interactive headline concept that puts the audience in control. Throughout the show, the crowd gets the chance to influence what happens next, creating a completely unique experience built around huge drops, unreleased music and the unpredictable energy that has made Crowd Control one of the most talked-about concepts in drum and bass.

Following massive shows and festival appearances around the world, K Motionz is bringing Crowd Control back to New Zealand for two huge shows this February

TSB Arena
Wellington

Public Sale: Wednesday 7th October 7:00PM

name: Quicksand (USA)
long_description:
New York post-hardcore legends QUICKSAND return to New Zealand in February 2027 for two shows across Auckland and Wellington, joined by Atlanta noise-rock heavyweights WHORES.




The tour follows the release of Quicksand’s new album Bring on the Psychics and their long-awaited return to New Zealand in 2023.

Formed in New York City in 1990, Quicksand emerged from the city’s hardcore scene before carving out a sound entirely their own. Landmark albums Slip and Manic Compression helped define their distinctive collision of crushing guitars, melody and atmosphere, influencing generations of alternative, post-hardcore and heavy music.

In 2027, Quicksand return with Bring on the Psychics, adding a new chapter to that catalogue alongside the songs that have made the band so enduring.

Joining Quicksand across both New Zealand shows are Atlanta noise-rock heavyweights WHORES.

Known for punishing riffs, abrasive intensity and ferocious live shows, Whores. return Down Under for the first time since touring Australia and New Zealand in 2022.




NEW ZEALAND 2027

Fri 19 Feb — Auckland — Double Whammy

Sat 20 Feb — Wellington — San Fran




Presale registration: waxstartouring.com/show/quicksand-usa/




Presale: Friday 9 October, 10am

General on sale: Monday 12 October, 10am
